_comment: Consumed by bin/audit_claude_md_drift.py: maps each rule stated in CLAUDE.md to the mechanism that enforces it, so a rule with no mechanism is visible rather than assumed.

rules.statement: The public v4 JSON contract is never changed for default requests (additive opt-in parameters only).

check.reason: no single command proves it. Partial guards: the integration suite asserts response shapes, `composer endpoints:check` pins the endpoint catalog, and tools/parity compares against a Lumen-era baseline that cannot be regenerated without that app. Otherwise it relies on review.

rules.statement: A change is not done until the suite, static analysis and OpenAPI generation pass.

check.command: grep -q phpunit .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q phpstan .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q l5-swagger:generate .github/workflows/ci.yml

rules.statement: Every enum in app/Enums keeps its spatie `@method static self value()` docblock declarations.
